# Condition-file schema {.unnumbered #condition-file-schema}

## Public interface {#condition-schema-public-interface}

Saved condition files are versioned public interfaces. A file contains application identification, a format name, a schema version, a timestamp, and a `conditions` object containing every persistent user setting for that page.

The ACC Magnetometer currently writes schema **6.14**, including the active
physics-model identifier and independent `gamma_u_A/B` uniform-relaxation
rates. Time evolution uses its own schema **2.4**, with the same physical
fields under an independent state namespace. Light shift and Atomic
polarizability use their own independently versioned formats.

## Loading {#condition-loading}

The loader validates application, format, and version identifiers before
applying values. ACC accepts only schema 6.14; Time evolution accepts only
schema 2.4 and the v3 coherent-model identifier. Older and future versions are rejected without migration, following
the user's explicit compatibility choice for this release. Required fields
are validated before their settings enter session state.

Time evolution requires exactly the current setting names. Missing fields
are rejected instead of being filled from defaults, and unknown fields are
rejected instead of being ignored. Total time must be in [0.001, 30] seconds
and pump turn-off time in [0, total time]. No historical duration extension
or per-field migration remains.

The `plotted_moments` list accepts Hyperfine polarization, Electron polarization,
F_x, F_y, F_z, Q_qq, Q_uv and Q_uu-Q_vv, without duplicates. Empty selection
hides all moment graphs. The former `moment_types` and `moment_manifolds`
fields are not part of this format. Both manifolds are always plotted.

Per-species `zeeman_axis_A/B` and `moment_axis_A/B` independently store x, y
or z, initially z. The former shared `q_axis_A/B` fields are not accepted.
The display selectors do not enter the physical integration or probe settings.

`probe_scan_min_MHz_A/B` and `probe_scan_max_MHz_A/B` store independent scan
limits, default −7000 and +7000 MHz relative to the selected zero-pressure
D-line center. Limits lie within ±15000 MHz, at least 10 MHz apart; the lower
bound is at most 14990 MHz and the upper bound at least −14990 MHz.

## Compatibility principles {#condition-compatibility-principles}

- Before future condition-sidebar changes, ask whether compatibility with older saved conditions is required.
- New defaults must not overwrite values loaded from a file.
- Renaming a page or navigation route does not by itself require a schema change.
- Changing the meaning, units, or structure of a stored field requires a new schema; migrations follow the user's requested compatibility policy.
- Unknown future schema versions are rejected rather than guessed.

## Probe-source settings {#probe-source-migration}

Time evolution schema 2.4 includes the source values
`Preset D1a`, `Preset D1b`, `Preset D2a`, and `Preset D2b`. These are weak,
nonperturbing probes available only on Time evolution. Selecting one fills
editable fields once using the current isotope: z, 1 cm, zero azimuth and ellipticity;
the `a` branches use $I+1/2\rightarrow I-1/2$ at −2000 MHz and the `b`
branches use $I-1/2\rightarrow I+1/2$ at +2000 MHz relative to the selected
pressure-shifted D1/D2 transition. Later edits are authoritative and are saved
with the selected source. Reruns and loading do not reapply preset defaults.
Fields use the existing units and names. ACC lists only its original Custom
Weak and weak/physical pump sources.
`PumpN weak` remains a nonperturbing readout, while ACC's plain `PumpN`
selects the physical pump. All reference menus always filter allowed
hyperfine transitions. The former `show_allowed_only` field is absent from
both current formats and does not control calculations or menus.

## Uniform-relaxation settings {#uniform-relaxation-migration}

Both current analysis formats require `gamma_u_A/B` as finite, nonnegative
numbers. New sessions default each rate to 1 s⁻¹. Invalid or missing rates
are rejected before settings are applied. No historical relaxation defaults
are inferred from older files because those formats are unsupported.

User workflow is described in [Condition files](../user-manual/condition-files.qmd).
